standard-dialogue-leagues-worlds.npc: Hello mortal. What do you seek?

options.text: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.player: What changes have been made for this League?

steps.npc: The great and terrible demon Yama has bound this League to his will.
Once again, regions contain monstrous Echo Bosses that can be defeated to earn unique and powerful rewards.
Yama, in his wisdom, has granted you the ability to augment your powers through Demonic Pacts. You may earn Demonic Pact points by completing Demonic Pact tasks.
Unlike before, you'll initially be restricted to the single Region of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
Additionally, Misthalin will not be available at all this League, and once you reach the first task threshold Karamja will be unlocked for free.
You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Info panel

steps.npc: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.player: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?

steps.npc: Demonic Pacts are new powers granted by Yama that modify and improve your combat abilities for the entire League.

steps.player: Why would Yama want to give me more power?

steps.npc: It wouldn't be very entertaining to see you go up against Echo Bosses with your mortal prowess now would it?
At least, not for very long. Death comes easily to your kind.
You can earn Demonic Pact points by completing specific combat tasks.
These points can be spent to unlock abilities and progress through the pacts in a manner that suits your preference for combat.
There are many choices available, but you will not be able to select them all. Plan ahead and choose wisely.
Now, would you like to take a look at the Demonic Pacts available to you?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Demonic Pacts panel

steps.npc: Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic. These artefacts have been reshaped by Yama and his cohort to grant new powers.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.

steps.text: As we speak, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Tasks panel

steps.npc: Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: How does the area system work?

steps.player: How does the area system work?

steps.npc: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
Once you have proven yourself dedicated to the League, Yama will also grant you free access to Karamja.
There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you are gifted. Choose wisely.
The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks you have been set.
The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Areas panel

steps.npc: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?
Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.
The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
League Points are earned by completing tasks.
Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?

steps.text: Opens Leagues Relics panel

steps.npc: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Can I claim some Combat rewards?

steps.player: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?

steps.text: No claimable rewards:

steps.npc: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.

steps.text: Has unclaimed rewards:

steps.npc: As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Currently, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be used to buy items on your main profile, although you can still browse the shop within the League.

steps.npc: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?

steps.text: Opens Rewards shop
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
You currently have the rank: Unranked.
As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

steps.player: Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?

options.text: Do I have any League items to collect?

steps.player: Do I have any League items to collect?

presenting-a-raids-megarare-voucher.npc: What an interesting scroll you seem to have stumbled across.
We'd be willing to let you take one of Gielinor's most powerful weapons from Yama's vault in exchange for it.

standard-dialogue-non-leagues-worlds.npc: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Leagues?

steps.npc: Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.

steps.player: A fresh start? Why would I want that?

steps.npc: Glory, rewards, and the chance to do things in a different way!
First up, the glory. Within a League, you can earn League Points by completing various tasks.
The more points you have, the better League Rank you will be given.
Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.
If that doesn't interest you, perhaps another reward might be more appealing? League Points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop.
You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to others!

steps.player: And if glory and rewards don't interest me?

steps.npc: Every League has unique rules and features. It's a very different world from the one you're used to.
For one thing, within the Leagues, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics which completely change the way you progress.
So even if glory and rewards aren't your thing, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

steps.npc: My pleasure!

options.text: Is there currently a League running?

steps.player: Is there currently a League running?

steps.npc: Yes! The current League is Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts.
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Demonic Pacts that let you choose new combat effects and improvements.
As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
You can also collect powerful artefacts known as Relics. Each one provides a different buff to your League experience.
One Relic allows you to harvest the souls of the slain, and another gives you the power to fell trees with your bare hands!
Of course, there are many other Relics to choose from.
One other thing. You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.

steps.player: Interesting. Maybe I should take part!

steps.npc: I'd highly recommend it!

steps.text: To take part in a League, you must be on a Leagues World. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

options.text: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.player: Can I purchase some League rewards?

steps.npc: Certainly! I have a number of unique rewards which you might be interested in.

options.text: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.player: Can we talk about League Trophies?

steps.npc: Of course! What would you like to know?
League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned.
There are seven tiers of League Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon.

options.text: I'd like to claim some League Trophies.

steps.text: Claiming trophies is temporarily disabled, please try again later.

options.text: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.player: What are the League Point cut-offs for the League Trophies?

steps.npc: Which League do you want to know about?
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 2,500 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 5,000 points. The Steel Trophy cut- off is 10,000 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 18,000 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 28,000 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 42,000 points.
Finally, the Dragon Trophy cut-off is 56,000 points.
